clauses.clause: Permanents you control gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
clauses.evidence: [cast]: you_bear, you_giant, you_charm, you_relic, you_land: keywords +HEXPROOF +INDESTRUCTIBLE (full hexproof, as printed; no opponent permanent changes); 'after the turn ends' all five -HEXPROOF -INDESTRUCTIBLE.
[cast]: SpellAbility(kind=INSTANT); mana G-1 W-1; card moves stack -> graveyard
clauses.issue: engine-limit: no priority, so the instant is only cast in its controller's own action window (cannot answer removal on the opponent's turn); weaker only.
